name: Mind Over Matter raises Chromie's Wisdom by 20% (#1969)
contract: Mind Over Matter 520923 carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS (8) and EffectSpellClassMask word2 bit 0x20000000; EffectBasePoints 19 resolves to 20 with DieSides 1, matching the tooltip "Increases the effectiveness of your Wisdom spells by $s1%." The family-28 records with SpellFamilyFlags word2 536870912 are exactly the Wisdom line (Nozdormu's Wisdom 572391-572396, Chromie's Wisdom 801523 and 802827-802834, Greater Chromie's Wisdom 680307). Chromie's Wisdom rank 802829, the highest a level-80 Chronomancer learns, has one effect: SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT (29) on STAT_SPIRIT with EffectBasePoints 39, i.e. +40 Spirit, which the talent takes to 48. Native path only: SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue calls Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, which applies SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS to every effect. The ratio window absorbs the int32 truncation of the percentage and any module base-value hook shifting the base.
